title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
summary: Signal is limiting users' ability to take screenshots in both its Android and iOS apps.
llm_summary: Signal has added a new restriction that blocks users from taking screenshots of conversations in both its Android and iOS apps. The change is part of the platform’s effort to guard against “existential” threats posed by AI‑driven surveillance tools that could capture and analyze private messages.
